mapper.sql: id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, task_type, status, attempt_count, recovery_count, worker_id, run_token, last_error, enqueued_at, started_at, heartbeat_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document_task (knowledge_base_id, document_id, task_type, status, attempt_count, recovery_count, worker_id, run_token, last_error, enqueued_at, started_at, heartbeat_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{recoveryCount}, NULL, NULL, #{lastError,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{enqueuedAt}, NULL, NULL, #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_document_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM knowledge_document_task WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND task_type = #{taskType} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM knowledge_document_task WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') ORDER BY enqueued_at, id
SELECT FROM knowledge_document_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY enqueued_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document_task SET status='PENDING', enqueued_at=#{enqueuedAt}, started_at=NULL, heartbeat_at=NULL, finished_at=NULL, worker_id=NULL, run_token=NULL, last_error=NULL, recovery_count=CASE WHEN #{resetRecoveryCount} THEN 0 ELSE recovery_count END WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE knowledge_document_task SET status='RUNNING', worker_id=#{workerId}, run_token=#{runToken}, started_at=#{now}, heartbeat_at=#{now}, finished_at=NULL, last_error=NULL, attempt_count=attempt_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_document_task SET heartbeat_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND run_token=#{runToken}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM knowledge_document_task WHERE status='RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY heartbeat_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document_task SET status='PENDING', recovery_count=recovery_count+1, enqueued_at=#{enqueuedAt}, started_at=NULL, heartbeat_at=NULL, finished_at=NULL, worker_id=NULL, run_token=NULL, last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE knowledge_document_task SET status='SUCCEEDED', finished_at=#{now}, heartbeat_at=#{now}, worker_id=NULL, run_token=NULL, last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE knowledge_document_task SET status='SUCCEEDED', finished_at=#{now}, heartbeat_at=NULL, worker_id=NULL, run_token=NULL, last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE knowledge_document_task SET status='FAILED', finished_at=#{now}, heartbeat_at=#{now}, worker_id=NULL, run_token=NULL, last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT d.id FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.status='PROCESSING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_task t WHERE t.document_id=d.id AND t.task_type='PROCESS' AND t.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'))

SELECT d.id FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.index_status='INDEXING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_task t WHERE t.document_id=d.id AND t.task_type='INDEX' AND t.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'))
